mappings.vector: distributed apex, velocity, acceleration, and cone axis
mappings.topology: Klein quotient/chart transition with explicit orientation
mappings.packing: bounded log-polar LUT cell address and declared payload
mappings.predicate: separate payload_parity_bit, topology_parity_bit, jitter_control_bit, and branch_control_bit plus visible failures
mappings.operator: ELP -> B0 -> P -> RBST -> K_T_forward -> Scone -> Pi -> U
mappings.self_reference: observable and residual update L[n+1] across a generation boundary

evidence_requirements.claim: The normalized NHDF stages are composed in one explicit bounded operator graph.
evidence_requirements.method: Bind a Merkle-addressed topological order and typed pipeline to the replay.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: The replay proof inventory resolves to the graph order, graph content hash, and typed feedback record.

evidence_requirements.claim: The selected NHDF coordinate, vector, kinematic, and geometry mechanisms have deterministic reference values.
evidence_requirements.method: Replay named log-polar, kinematic, and geometry records under the declared numeric policy.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: Every referenced record exists in the sealed replay and the proof inventory marks the vector set passed.

evidence_requirements.claim: The composed replay stays within explicit finite generation, branch, LUT, recipe, and display bounds.
evidence_requirements.method: Record declared limits, observed use, and a boolean result for each bounded resource.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: All resource trace entries are present and passed without truncating authoritative state.

evidence_requirements.claim: Feedback crosses exactly one generation boundary without a same-generation or fixed-point claim.
evidence_requirements.method: Bind the feedback edge and atomic transition hashes to source generation n and target generation n+1.
evidence_requirements.pass_condition: The feedback and transition records agree on n to n+1 and both fixed-point claims are false.
